statement: Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in curve and NURBS editing with "Toggle Cyclic"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.

Change what is selected in curve and NURBS editing with "(De)select First"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Change what is selected in curve and NURBS editing with "(De)select Last"; the new selection is what the next edit command acts on, no data is modified, and one undo step restores the previous selection.

Run the data operation "Decimate Curve" on the current selection in curve and NURBS editing; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.
Remove or clear content in curve and NURBS editing with "Delete"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in curve and NURBS editing with "Dissolve Vertices"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in curve and NURBS editing with "Draw Curve"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Copy content in curve and NURBS editing with "Duplicate Curve"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.
